sentences.Monica har invitert noen av vennene sine: Monica has invited some of her friends from the Norwegian course round.
sentences.Det er så hyggelig å se dere igjen!: It's so nice to see you again!
Likewise. It's been a long time.
sentences.Hva gjør du nå, Monica?: What are you doing now, Monica?
I work full-time at a hotel.
sentences.Og dere da, hva driver dere med? Har du: And what about you, what are you up to? Have you got a job, Pablo?
sentences.Nei, men jeg har søkt mange slags jobber: No, but I've applied for lots of different jobs.
I'd like to become a journalist.
sentences.Har du erfaring fra slikt arbeid?: Do you have any experience of that kind of work?
sentences.Ja, jeg skriver litt om Skandinavia i et: Yes, I write a bit about Scandinavia for an Argentinian magazine.
sentences.Jeg søker også jobber. Da jeg bodde i So: I'm looking for jobs too. When I lived in Somalia, I worked with accounts in a company.
sentences.Hva holder du på med, Haifa?: What are you up to, Haifa?
sentences.Jeg skal studere. Jeg har lyst til å bli: I'm going to study. I want to become a police officer.
sentences.Det er en viktig jobb, og jeg liker utfo: It's an important job, and I like challenges.
sentences.Men først må jeg ta førerkort. Jeg skal: But first I have to get my driving licence. I'm going to take driving lessons now.
sentences.Leser du teoridelen på norsk?: Are you reading the theory part in Norwegian?
sentences.Ja, og det er ganske vanskelig. Det er m: Yes, and it's quite hard. There are lots of new words.
sentences.Enig. Det er ikke lett. Jeg tok førerkor: I agree. It's not easy. I got my driving licence a while ago, and I had to take the theory test several times.
sentences.Har du sjekket på nettet? Der finnes det: Have you checked online? There are tests there that you can take to practise.
sentences.Det visste jeg ikke. Takk for tipset!: I didn't know that. Thanks for the tip!
sentences.Jeg skal hilse fra Anne, læreren vår. Je: Anne, our teacher, says hello. I met her in town yesterday.
sentences.Så hyggelig. Det var fint på norskkurset: How nice. It was great on the Norwegian course.
sentences.Ja, jeg savner skolen av og til. Men nå: Yes, I miss school sometimes. But now I'm looking forward to getting a job.
sentences.Skål for det! Jeg håper alle får oppfylt: Cheers to that! I hope everyone gets their wishes.
